captureMethod: RenderTargetBitmap of visible production WPF windows
interaction: Production protection/export/save/backup/lock/recovery services and visible WPF dialogs, isolated disposable files; see stage8.json for distinct recovery outcomes
limitations: Native save/backup decisions supplied by queues. No physical input, Windows sleep/lock or disk-full test. Crash recovery is exercised through the service and re-created coordinator, not a nonexistent user recovery prompt. No passwords retained.
